text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And the winner of the Satsuki Sho, the<n>first of the
Classic Triple Crown, is<n>none other than...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Gasp... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin! Narita Taishin has<n>emerged
victorious!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ngh... My head hurts. Ugh... But still...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I won! Hah! I hope all my haters saw<n>that! They'll
never say I'm not good<n>enough ever again!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What happened in that race? And<n>what is this
feeling?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: (Urk!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(I still feel so overwhelmed by the<n>intensity in her
voice!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket, are you...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What if this had been the Derby? I... I<n>would've
lost...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! This is no time to show<n>weakness! I gotta
stay STRONG!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the Derby Champion! I<n>WILL make it
happen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide returns to the waiting<n>room with a
dark expression on her<n>face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is all because I let myself<n>become arrogant... Or
maybe it means<n>there's a flaw in my equation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And if that's the case, I simply need<n>to find a way
to fix it. Everything will<n>be fine. There has to be a
solution.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This was but the result of a<n>miscalculation and
nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As long as I fix it, the equation should<n>behave
predictably, and I won't have<n>to worry about ever
losing...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her voice keeps getting smaller and<n>smaller until
she's nearly inaudible.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the miscalculation was, she<n>seems pretty
shaken. She must have<n>discovered something
worrying. Still...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is tenacious and persists at full<n>speed until
the very end... And the<n>ferocity of Taishin's pursuit
is<n>unparalleled.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Both of them are first-class<n>competitors in their own
right.<n>They're incredible.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
What could have happened in this<n>race to make
them outliers in her<n>calculations?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I might have lost, but at least I've<n>obtained new
data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's reanalyze things right away.<n>There's not
much time left until the<n>Derby, so we can't waste
any time...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next stop on our journey<n>together is the
second race of the<n>Classic Triple Crown tour—the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But hearing such urgency in her voice<n>makes me
worry that something in<n>her is beginning to crack.
